Batch duration statistics are first-pass only; effective arm throughput includes its retry wall time and worker seconds.
Intra-batch position quality uses only first-pass valid words, with failures in the pass-rate denominator; retries cannot hide dilution.
Character counts use Unicode code points and compact JSON; definition lengths average teaching definitions plus attested sense translations, absent optional mt_definition counts as zero.
Collocation length sums mt/en/zh per collocation; dialogue length sums mt_spoken/en/zh per word (no duplicate standard restoration).
Input size measures the explicit stdin prompt only, excluding CLI/system instructions. Token estimates use ceil(input_chars/4); no model tokenizer or billing token count is claimed.
Five gates are deterministic structure/evidence checks; independent native-language, browser and listening review remain separate.

abatija.gloss_zh: 修道院；女修道院；孤儿院

teaching_sense.en_definition: A religious house where a community of monks or nuns lives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供修士或修女组成的宗教团体共同生活的修道院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar reliġjuża fejn tgħix komunità ta' patrijiet jew sorijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修道院；女修道院。
收容、照料孤儿的机构；孤儿院。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dar fejn jgħixu u jingħataw kura tfal orfni.

formal.mt: L-istudenti żaru l-abatija biex jitgħallmu dwar il-ħajja tal-komunità reliġjuża.
formal.en: The students visited the abbey to learn about the life of the religious community.
formal.zh: 学生们参观了修道院，以了解宗教团体的生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid iżżur l-abatija għada? Pawlu: Iva, nixtieq nara l-ġnien tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to visit the abbey tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, I'd like to see its garden.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天想去参观修道院吗？Pawlu：想，我想看看那里的花园。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.en: Do you want to visit the abbey tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)

messages.en: Yes, I'd like to see its garden.

abatija.cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张场景卡记忆：宗教团体共同生活的院落对应“修道院”，照料孤儿的机构对应“孤儿院”；阅读时靠上下文选择词义。

abbanduna.gloss_zh: 放弃；遗弃；离弃；疏于照顾

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave someone or something behind, give something up, or stop providing care or support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 离开或抛下某人、某物，放弃某事，或停止给予照顾与支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħalli lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa warajh, jieqaf minn xi ħaġa, jew ma jibqax jagħti kura jew appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 放弃某事；抛弃或遗弃某人、某物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iħalli lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa warajh, jew jieqaf minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 离弃本应陪伴的人，或擅自离开本应留守的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jitlaq u jħalli lil xi ħadd jew post li suppost jibqa' miegħu jew fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疏于照顾；不再关心或支持；离弃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jonqos milli jieħu ħsieb lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew ma jibqax jagħti appoġġ.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddeċieda li jabbanduna l-pjan minħabba n-nuqqas ta' fondi.
formal.en: The committee decided to abandon the plan because of a lack of funds.
formal.zh: 委员会因资金不足而决定放弃这项计划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex abbandunajt il-kors? Pawlu: Għax bdejt xogħol ġdid u ma kellix ħin biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you drop the course? Pawlu: Because I started a new job and didn't have enough time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么放弃了那门课程？Pawlu：因为我开始了一份新工作，没有足够的时间。

messages.en: Why did you drop the course?

messages.zh: 因为我开始了一份新工作，没有足够的时间。

abbanduna.cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“放弃计划、离弃同伴、疏于照顾”三个画面中记忆；共同线索是原本的行动、陪伴或照顾不再继续。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The nun who leads an abbey or a community of nuns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 领导女修道院或修女团体的修女；女修道院院长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-soru li tmexxi abatija jew komunità ta' sorijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女修道院院长；领导修女团体的女院长。

collocations.zh: 一位新任女修道院院长

formal.mt: Il-komunità għażlet abbatissa ġdida biex tmexxi l-abatija.
formal.en: The community chose a new abbess to lead the abbey.
formal.zh: 这个团体选出了一位新任女院长来领导修道院。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jilqagħna fl-abatija? Pawlu: L-abbatissa se tilqagħna fid-daħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will welcome us at the abbey? Pawlu: The abbess will welcome us at the entrance.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁会在修道院接待我们？Pawlu：女院长会在入口处接待我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 谁会在修道院接待我们？
messages.en: Who will welcome us at the abbey?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.zh: 女院长会在入口处接待我们。
messages.en: The abbess will welcome us at the entrance.

abbatissa.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 abatija 和 abbatissa 配成“地点与人物”学习卡：前者是修道院，后者是领导女修道院的院长；这是词义配对记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The capacity or skill to do something successfully.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够成功完成某事的能力或技能。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kapaċità jew il-ħila li tagħmel xi ħaġa b'suċċess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 做某事的能力；完成某项任务的本领。
熟练完成某项活动的技能或技巧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħila li tagħmel attività b'mod tajjeb u effettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能力、技能，或学习和从事某类活动的资质与才干。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kapaċità, ħila jew talent biex titgħallem jew tagħmel xi ħaġa.

formal.mt: Il-kors jgħin lill-istudenti jiżviluppaw l-abbiltà li jsolvu problemi b'mod indipendenti.
formal.en: The course helps students develop the ability to solve problems independently.
formal.zh: 这门课程帮助学生培养独立解决问题的能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi bżonn intejjeb l-abbiltà tiegħi fil-kitba. Pawlu: Nistgħu nipprattikaw flimkien kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: I need to improve my writing skills. Pawlu: We can practise together every week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我需要提高自己的写作能力。Pawlu：我们可以每周一起练习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn intejjeb l-abbiltà tiegħi fil-kitba.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn intejjeb l-abbiltà tiegħi fil-kitba.
messages.zh: 我需要提高自己的写作能力。
messages.en: I need to improve my writing skills.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)

messages.en: We can practise together every week.

abbiltà.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“能做什么、做得多熟练、学起来是否有资质”三问记忆，分别联想到能力、技能和资质，再用写作能力这一具体搭配巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very deep chasm; figuratively, a very large difference between people, things, or situations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极深的裂谷或深渊；也比喻人与人、事物或处境之间的巨大差距。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xaqq fond ħafna fl-art; b'mod figurattiv, differenza kbira ħafna bejn nies, affarijiet jew sitwazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深渊；极深的裂谷。
巨大差距；很大的差别。

collocations.en: a vast gap between the rich and the poor

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri abbiss bejn il-pagi taż-żewġ gruppi ta' ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report reveals a vast gap between the wages of the two groups of workers.
formal.zh: 报告显示，两组工人的工资之间存在巨大差距。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif marru ż-żewġ timijiet? Pawlu: Hemm abbiss bejniethom! Wieħed lagħab tajjeb ħafna u l-ieħor bilkemm mess il-ballun.

abbon.gloss_zh: 减免；解除；缓解；折扣；返还

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reduction or remission of an amount due, including a discount or rebate; also release or relief from a burden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对应付金额的减少或免除，包括折扣或返还；也指负担的解除或缓解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqis jew maħfra ta' ammont dovut, inkluż skont jew ħlas lura; ukoll ħelsien jew serħan minn piż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减轻；减少，尤指应付金额或负担的降低。
解除；免除，使人摆脱某种负担或义务。
缓解；减轻负担后得到的宽缓。
减免；对应付款项或所承担义务的部分或全部免除。
折扣；减价；已付款项的部分返还。

collocations.en: to be granted a reduction or remission

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tat abbon fuq il-prezz minħabba ħsara żgħira fil-prodott.
formal.en: The company granted a discount on the price because of minor damage to the product.
formal.zh: 由于产品存在轻微损坏，公司给予了价格折扣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement to receive a publication or use a service for a period of time, usually in return for payment.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel intense hatred or disgust toward someone or something.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗为什么电影看到一半就走了？

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 先写出文字的初稿，或画出草图、勾勒概要，供之后修改和完善。

画草图；用简略线条画出初步形象。
勾勒；概略描述或列出主要内容。

formal.en: The committee drafted a plan for the project and sent it to the members for their comments.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Abbozza messaġġ qasir, u mbagħad naqrawh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Abbozza messaġġ qasir, u mbagħad naqrawh flimkien.

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来代替完整词语或短语的简短形式，即缩写或缩略形式。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 君主正式放弃自己的王位及相应权力，即退位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirrinunzja formalment għat-tron u għas-setgħa tiegħu bħala monarka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 退位；君主正式放弃王位。

abdilla.gloss_zh: Abdilla（姓氏，可音译为“阿布迪拉”）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A surname used as a person's family name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作个人姓氏的专名，写作 Abdilla，首字母大写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom ta' persuna, miktub Abdilla b'ittra kbira fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姓氏：Abdilla，可音译为“阿布迪拉”。

formal.mt: Is-Sur Abdilla bagħat it-talba tiegħu bil-miktub u rċieva konferma mill-uffiċċju.

messages.speaker: David (访客)
messages.zh: Abdilla，拼作 A-B-D-I-L-L-A。
messages.en: Abdilla. It's spelled A-B-D-I-L-L-A.

abdilla.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Abdilla 写在模拟姓名牌的姓氏栏，旁边配上“阿布迪拉先生”；记住首字母大写，并留意拼写中连续的两个 l。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To live in a particular place or dwelling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个地方或住所生活、居住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħix f'post jew f'dar partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 居住于；在某地生活。

collocations.en: he lived in a small house
collocations.zh: 他曾住在一所小房子里

formal.mt: L-awtur abita f'din id-dar għal għaxar snin.
formal.en: The author lived in this house for ten years.
formal.zh: 这位作家曾在这所房子里住了十年。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nannu tiegħek abita hawn? Mark: Iva, abita f'din id-dar għal ħafna snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did your grandfather live here? Mark: Yes, he lived in this house for many years.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷以前住在这里吗？
messages.en: Did your grandfather live here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, abita f'din id-dar għal ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, abita f'din id-dar għal ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 对，他在这所房子里住了很多年。
messages.en: Yes, he lived in this house for many years.

abita.cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词和一扇家门联系起来，记住整句 abita f'din id-dar，意思是“他曾住在这所房子里”。

abitat.gloss_zh: 有人居住的地方；建成区

teaching_sense.en_definition: A built-up area where people live.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有人居住、房屋等建筑较为集中的区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona mibnija fejn jgħixu n-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有人居住的地方。
有人群居住的地方。
建成区；建筑物较为集中的区域。

collocations.en: the edge of the built-up area

formal.mt: Il-proġett jipprevedi triq ġdida fit-tarf tal-abitat.

formal.zh: 该项目规划在建成区边缘修建一条新路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-razzett jinsab ħdejn id-djar? Mark: Le, jinsab barra mill-abitat, ħdejn l-għelieqi.

messages.zh: 不，在建成区外面，靠近田地。
messages.en: No, it is outside the built-up area, near the fields.

abitat.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上房屋密集、有人生活的一片区域，用 abitat 给它贴标签，再用“区域边缘”和“区域外面”两个场景巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very white; as white as snow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容颜色非常洁白，像牛奶或雪一样白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Abjad ħafna, bħall-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像雪一样白的；雪白的。

formal.mt: Għall-wirja ntgħażel drapp abjad ħalib biex jgħatti l-mejda.
formal.en: Milk-white fabric was chosen to cover the table for the exhibition.
formal.zh: 展览选用了洁白如奶的布料来铺盖桌子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema drapp se nixtru? Mark: Dan abjad ħalib; ikun sabiħ fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which fabric shall we buy? Mark: This milk-white one; it will look lovely on the table.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们买哪块布？Mark：这块洁白如奶的吧，铺在桌上会很好看。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 我们买哪块布？
messages.en: Which fabric shall we buy?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan abjad ħalib; ikun sabiħ fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Dan abjad ħalib; ikun sabiħ fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 这块洁白如奶的吧，铺在桌上会很好看。
messages.en: This milk-white one; it will look lovely on the table.

abjad ħalib.cognitive_memory_aid: 把一杯牛奶放在白布旁边：abjad 表示白，ħalib 表示牛奶，把整组表达记成“白得像牛奶”，帮助联想雪白的程度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very white; as white as snow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容颜色非常洁白，像棉花或雪一样白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Abjad ħafna, bħall-qoton.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 像雪一样白的；雪白的。

collocations.zh: 洁白如棉的羊毛或绒毛

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidher raġel anzjan b'xagħar abjad qoton.
formal.en: The photograph shows an elderly man with cotton-white hair.
formal.zh: 照片中是一位头发洁白如棉的老人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-ġeru! Mark: Kemm hu ħelu! Għandu suf abjad qoton.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that puppy! Mark: How cute! It has cotton-white fur.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看那只小狗！Mark：真可爱！它的毛像棉花一样白。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那只小狗！
messages.en: Look at that puppy!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu ħelu! Għandu suf abjad qoton.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu ħelu! Għandu suf abjad qoton.
messages.zh: 真可爱！它的毛像棉花一样白。
messages.en: How cute! It has cotton-white fur.

abjad qoton.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一团洁白棉花贴在老人的白发旁：abjad 表示白，qoton 表示棉花，用“白得像棉花”记住这组表达强调雪白的颜色。

abjura.gloss_zh: 正式声明放弃；宣誓弃绝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally renounce a belief, faith, or conviction previously held.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式声明放弃自己原先持有的信仰、信念或主张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiċħad b'mod formali twemmin, fidi jew konvinzjoni li qabel kont tħaddan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正式弃绝；声明放弃信仰、信念或主张
正式弃绝或宣誓放弃信仰、信念等的行为

collocations.zh: 他正式放弃了自己的信念

formal.mt: Fid-dikjarazzjoni tiegħu, ir-raġel abjura t-twemmin li qabel kien iħaddan.
formal.en: In his declaration, the man formally renounced the beliefs he had previously held.
formal.zh: 在声明中，这名男子正式弃绝了自己原先持有的信念。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser li xi ħadd abjura t-twemmin tiegħu? Mark: Ifisser li ddikjara b'mod formali li ma baqax jemmen fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does it mean that someone abjured their beliefs? Mark: It means they formally declared that they no longer believed in them.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：说某人弃绝了自己的信念，是什么意思？马克：意思是他正式声明自己不再相信那些信念。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser li xi ħadd abjura t-twemmin tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser li xi ħadd abjura t-twemmin tiegħu?
messages.zh: 说某人弃绝了自己的信念，是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that someone abjured their beliefs?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)

messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li ddikjara b'mod formali li ma baqax jemmen fih.
messages.zh: 意思是他正式声明自己不再相信那些信念。
messages.en: It means they formally declared that they no longer believed in them.

abjura.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 abjura 放进“郑重声明放弃原有信念”的画面来记：重点是明确弃绝，比日常说“不喜欢了”更正式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The official ending or removal of a law, system, practice, or charge.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式终止或取消某项法律、制度、惯例或收费。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tneħħija uffiċjali ta' liġi, sistema, prattika jew miżata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 废除；正式取消法律、制度或惯例等

collocations.en: the abolition of the death penalty

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda l-abolizzjoni ta' din il-miżata sabiex jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The report recommends abolishing this fee to reduce costs for students.
formal.zh: 报告建议取消这项收费，以减轻学生的费用负担。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'taħseb dwar l-abolizzjoni tal-miżata? Mark: Naħseb li tgħin lill-istudenti jiffrankaw ftit flus.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you think about abolishing the fee? Mark: I think it will help students save some money.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得取消这项收费怎么样？马克：我觉得这能帮学生省一点钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 你觉得取消这项收费怎么样？

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)

messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li tgħin lill-istudenti jiffrankaw ftit flus.
messages.zh: 我觉得这能帮学生省一点钱。

abolizzjoni.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 abolizzjoni 和一张盖着“正式取消”印章的收费通知联系起来：记住它表示废除这一行为，而不是暂时停用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hollow beneath the joint where the arm meets the shoulder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手臂与肩部连接处下方的凹陷部位，即腋窝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħofra taħt il-ġog fejn id-driegħ jingħaqad mal-ispalla.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami, il-pazjent indika li kellu uġigħ fl-abt tal-lemin.

formal.zh: 检查时，患者表示自己的右侧腋窝疼痛。

abt.cognitive_memory_aid: 记 abt 时想象抬起手臂指向腋窝，再把手臂夹回身体旁；用“腋下夹体温计”的动作帮助记住这个身体部位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To enter or use a system, or to open and obtain information or a resource.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入或使用某个系统，或打开并获取其中的信息或资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħol f'sistema jew tiftaħ u tuża informazzjoni jew riżorsa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 访问、进入或使用系统、信息或资源

formal.zh: 该用户通过自己的账户访问了系统，并下载了报告。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The personal name Adam, used to identify a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人名“亚当”，用于指称一个人，书写时首字母大写。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亚当（人名）。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To change something so that it fits a particular purpose, situation, or need.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 改编；使某物适合某种用途、对象或情境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very cute or charming in a way that makes people feel affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十分可爱、讨人喜欢的，让人产生喜爱或亲近之情的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħelu ħafna jew tant simpatiku li jqanqal l-imħabba u l-għożża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可爱的；惹人喜爱的；令人怜爱的。

messages.zh: 它真可爱！它叫什么名字？
messages.en: He's so adorable! What's his name?

adorabbli.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小狗睡在妈妈身边，让人忍不住说“真可爱！”；把这个画面和感叹句 Kemm hu adorabbli! 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take a child or animal into one's family, or to accept and begin using an idea, method, or rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把孩子或动物接纳为家庭成员；也指接受并开始采用某种想法、方法或规则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu tifel jew annimal bħala membru tal-familja tiegħu, jew jaċċetta u jibda juża idea, metodu jew regola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收养孩子或领养动物；也可指采纳、采用某种想法、方法或规则。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat adotta regoli ġodda biex itejjeb l-organizzazzjoni tal-laqgħat.
formal.en: The committee adopted new rules to improve the organization of meetings.
formal.zh: 委员会采纳了新规则，以改善会议的组织安排。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min adotta dan il-qattus? Mark: Ħija. Issa l-qattus jgħix miegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who adopted this cat? Mark: My brother. The cat lives with him now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁领养了这只猫？马克：我哥哥。现在这只猫和他一起生活。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁领养了这只猫？
messages.en: Who adopted this cat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我哥哥。现在这只猫和他一起生活。
messages.en: My brother. The cat lives with him now.

adotta.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“接纳进来”串联两个用法：把猫接进家里是领养，把新方法接进工作中是采纳；两种情境都可用 adotta。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of taking a child into a family as one's own, or of accepting and beginning to use a method, practice, or policy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将儿童接纳为自己家庭子女的收养行为；也指接受并开始使用某种方法、做法或政策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li wieħed jilqa' tifel jew tifla fil-familja bħala wild tiegħu, jew li jaċċetta u jibda juża metodu, prattika jew politika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收养；采用、采纳。
收养；采用、采纳。

collocations.en: the adoption of a new method

formal.mt: L-adozzjoni ta' metodu ġdid ta' tagħlim tista' tgħin lill-istudenti jifhmu aħjar is-suġġett.
formal.en: The adoption of a new teaching method can help students understand the subject better.
formal.zh: 采用新的教学方法可以帮助学生更好地理解这门学科。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Qed naħsbu fl-adozzjoni. Pawlu: Tkellimtu ma' xi ħadd li jista' jispjegalkom il-proċess? Marija: Iva, għandna appuntament il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Marija: We're thinking about adoption. Pawlu: Have you spoken to anyone who can explain the process to you? Marija: Yes, we have an appointment next week.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我们正在考虑收养。保罗：你们和能向你们解释流程的人谈过了吗？玛丽娅：谈过了，我们约好了下周见面。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们正在考虑收养。
messages.en: We're thinking about adoption.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkellimtu ma' xi ħadd li jista' jispjegalkom il-proċess?
messages.mt_standard: Tkellimtu ma' xi ħadd li jista' jispjegalkom il-proċess?
messages.zh: 你们和能向你们解释流程的人谈过了吗？
messages.en: Have you spoken to anyone who can explain the process to you?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 谈过了，我们约好了下周见面。
messages.en: Yes, we have an appointment next week.

adozzjoni.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 adozzjoni 和“接纳进来”这个画面联系起来：接纳儿童成为家人是收养，接纳新方法并开始使用是采用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To love or admire someone or something very deeply, or to show religious devotion to God or a deity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常深切地喜爱或仰慕某人、某物；也指以宗教虔诚敬拜上帝或神明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħobb jew jammira ħafna lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew juri devozzjoni reliġjuża lejn Alla jew divinità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深爱；极其喜爱；非常仰慕。
深爱、崇拜；敬拜上帝或神明。

formal.mt: Il-komunità tinġabar fil-knisja biex tadura lil Alla permezz tat-talb u l-kant.
formal.en: The community gathers in the church to worship God through prayer and singing.
formal.zh: 教会团体聚集在教堂，通过祈祷和歌唱敬拜上帝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: In-nannu jadura lin-neputijiet tiegħu. Mark: Veru! Dejjem jitbissem meta jarahom. Lara: U dejjem isib ħin biex jilgħab magħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Grandpa adores his grandchildren. Mark: He really does! He always smiles when he sees them. Lara: And he always finds time to play with them.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：爷爷特别疼爱他的孙辈。马克：确实！他一见到他们就笑。拉拉：而且他总会抽时间陪他们玩。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷特别疼爱他的孙辈。
messages.en: Grandpa adores his grandchildren.

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.zh: 确实！他一见到他们就笑。
messages.en: He really does! He always smiles when he sees them.

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: U dejjem isib ħin biex jilgħab magħhom.
messages.mt_standard: U dejjem isib ħin biex jilgħab magħhom.
messages.zh: 而且他总会抽时间陪他们玩。
messages.en: And he always finds time to play with them.

adura.cognitive_memory_aid: 记 adura 时想象两幅画面：爷爷满心疼爱孙辈，信徒虔诚敬拜上帝；共同点是非常深切的爱与敬意。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To attract and hold someone's attention strongly by being interesting, beautiful, or charming.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因有趣、美丽或富有魅力而强烈吸引并持续抓住某人的注意力，使其着迷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiġbed u jżomm l-attenzjoni ta' xi ħadd għax ikun interessanti, sabiħ jew mimli seħer.

sense_translations.en_definition: to charm, to fascinate, to enchant
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以魅力吸引、迷住某人；使着迷或陶醉。

formal.mt: Ir-rakkont tal-esploratur affaxxina lill-udjenza bid-dettalji tiegħu dwar il-ħajja fil-baħar.
formal.en: The explorer's account fascinated the audience with its details about life in the sea.
formal.zh: 这位探险家的叙述以有关海洋生命的细节深深吸引了观众。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dak il-film affaxxina lil kulħadd! David: Veru, lanqas indunajt li għaddew sagħtejn. Nina: Jien irrid nerġa' narah.
colloquial.en: Nina: That film fascinated everyone! David: True, I didn't even notice that two hours had passed. Nina: I want to watch it again.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那部电影把大家都迷住了！戴维：确实，我都没察觉已经过了两个小时。妮娜：我想再看一遍。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 那部电影把大家都迷住了！
messages.en: That film fascinated everyone!

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, lanqas indunajt li għaddew sagħtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, lanqas indunajt li għaddew sagħtejn.
messages.zh: 确实，我都没察觉已经过了两个小时。
messages.en: True, I didn't even notice that two hours had passed.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想再看一遍。
messages.en: I want to watch it again.

affaxxina.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 affaxxina 记成“精彩得忘了时间”：故事、电影或表演牢牢吸引注意力，让观众看得入迷。

afferma.gloss_zh: 肯定；明确陈述；确认；断言

teaching_sense.en_definition: To state something clearly and confidently as true, or to confirm that something is the case.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清楚而肯定地陈述某事为真，或确认某种情况确实存在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid b'mod ċar u b'ċertezza li xi ħaġa hija vera, jew jikkonferma li xi ħaġa hija hekk.

sense_translations.en_definition: to affirm, to state, to confirm, to assert
sense_translations.zh_definition: 肯定、明确陈述；确认；坚称或断言某事为真。

collocations.zh: 肯定地表示自己已准备好

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, id-direttur afferma li l-proġett kien miexi skont il-pjan.
formal.en: In his report, the director stated that the project was progressing according to plan.
formal.zh: 主任在报告中明确表示，项目正在按计划推进。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Pawlu afferma li se jiġi għada. Toni: Tajjeb, allura nistgħu nżommu post għalih. Sara: Iva, se nżid ismu mal-lista.
colloquial.en: Sara: Pawlu confirmed that he's coming tomorrow. Toni: Good, then we can save him a place. Sara: Yes, I'll add his name to the list.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：保罗确认他明天会来。托尼：好，那我们可以给他留个位置。萨拉：嗯，我会把他的名字加到名单上。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu afferma li se jiġi għada.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu afferma li se jiġi għada.
messages.zh: 保罗确认他明天会来。
messages.en: Pawlu confirmed that he's coming tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Toni (活动协助者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, allura nistgħu nżommu post għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, allura nistgħu nżommu post għalih.
messages.zh: 好，那我们可以给他留个位置。
messages.en: Good, then we can save him a place.

messages.speaker: Sara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 嗯，我会把他的名字加到名单上。
messages.en: Yes, I'll add his name to the list.

afferma.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 afferma 和“点头后明确说出来”联系起来：说得肯定是断言，把情况说清楚是陈述，再次肯定消息是确认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel affection for someone or something, or to become emotionally attached to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜爱某人或某物，或逐渐对其产生亲近、依恋的感情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss imħabba jew għożża lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew tintrabat magħhom emozzjonalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜爱；对某人或某物怀有亲近、依恋的感情。

collocations.en: to become attached to the dog
to become fond of the teacher
collocations.zh: 逐渐喜欢并亲近那位老师

formal.mt: Matul is-sena skolastika, it-tifel affezzjona ruħu mal-għalliem li kien jgħinu fil-qari kuljum.
formal.en: During the school year, the boy became fond of the teacher who helped him with reading every day.
formal.zh: 这一学年里，男孩逐渐喜欢上了那位每天帮助他阅读的老师。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer it-tifel bil-kelb il-ġdid? Lara: Tajjeb ħafna! Affezzjona ruħu miegħu u jilgħab miegħu kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the boy getting on with the new dog? Lara: Really well! He's become attached to him and plays with him every day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：孩子和新来的狗相处得怎么样？Lara：特别好！他已经对它有感情了，每天都和它玩。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 孩子和新来的狗相处得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the boy getting on with the new dog?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb ħafna! Affezzjona ruħu miegħu u jilgħab miegħu kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb ħafna! Affezzjona ruħu miegħu u jilgħab miegħu kuljum.
messages.zh: 特别好！他已经对它有感情了，每天都和它玩。
messages.en: Really well! He's become attached to him and plays with him every day.

affezzjona.cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“每天陪小狗玩，渐渐舍不得它”的画面绑定，记住它表达喜爱和依恋；连同 affezzjona ruħu miegħu 一起练习。

affilja.gloss_zh: 使加入；使隶属；加入组织

teaching_sense.en_definition: To formally connect a person or group with an organization, or to join an organization.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使个人或团体与某个组织建立正式的成员或隶属关系，也可指加入某个组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Torbot persuna jew grupp ma' organizzazzjoni b'mod uffiċjali, jew tissieħeb f'organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使加入某个组织；使建立正式的隶属或成员关系；加入。

collocations.en: to affiliate a club with a federation

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddeċieda li jaffilja l-klabb ma' federazzjoni nazzjonali sabiex il-membri jkunu jistgħu jieħdu sehem fil-kompetizzjonijiet tagħha.
formal.en: The committee decided to affiliate the club with a national federation so that its members could take part in the federation's competitions.
formal.zh: 委员会决定让俱乐部加入一个全国性联合会，以便会员能够参加该联合会举办的比赛。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex trid taffilja ruħek ma' unjin? Sara: Biex ikolli min jagħtini parir jekk ikolli problema fuq ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why do you want to join a union? Sara: So I'll have someone to advise me if I have a problem at work.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么想加入工会？Sara：这样，如果我在工作中遇到问题，就有人能给我建议。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex trid taffilja ruħek ma' unjin?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex trid taffilja ruħek ma' unjin?
messages.zh: 你为什么想加入工会？
messages.en: Why do you want to join a union?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ikolli min jagħtini parir jekk ikolli problema fuq ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ikolli min jagħtini parir jekk ikolli problema fuq ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 这样，如果我在工作中遇到问题，就有人能给我建议。
messages.en: So I'll have someone to advise me if I have a problem at work.

affilja.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把自己的姓名写进组织的会员名册：affilja 记“正式加入、建立隶属关系”。用“人加入工会、俱乐部加入联合会”两个画面区分用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have enough money, time, or other resources to pay for something or undertake an action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有足够的金钱、时间或其他资源购买某物或承担某项行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollok biżżejjed flus, ħin jew riżorsi oħra biex tixtri xi ħaġa jew tagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负担得起某项费用；有足够的时间、资源或余地做某事。

collocations.en: to afford to take a day off

formal.mt: Qabel ma tiffirma l-kuntratt, il-familja għandha tivverifika jekk tistax taffordja l-kera u l-ispejjeż l-oħra ta' kull xahar.
formal.en: Before signing the contract, the family should check whether it can afford the rent and the other monthly expenses.
formal.zh: 签订合同前，这家人应核实自己是否负担得起房租及其他每月开支。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tiġi magħna nieklu barra llejla? Mark: Nixtieq, imma dan ix-xahar ma nistax naffordja ikla oħra barra. Nieklu d-dar flimkien?
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you coming out to eat with us tonight? Mark: I'd like to, but I can't afford another meal out this month. Shall we eat at home together?
colloquial.zh: Lara：今晚和我们一起出去吃饭吗？Mark：我很想去，不过这个月我没钱再出去吃一顿了。我们一起在家吃，好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚和我们一起出去吃饭吗？
messages.en: Are you coming out to eat with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq, imma dan ix-xahar ma nistax naffordja ikla oħra barra. Nieklu d-dar flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq, imma dan ix-xahar ma nistax naffordja ikla oħra barra. Nieklu d-dar flimkien?
messages.zh: 我很想去，不过这个月我没钱再出去吃一顿了。我们一起在家吃，好吗？
messages.en: I'd like to, but I can't afford another meal out this month. Shall we eat at home together?

affordja.cognitive_memory_aid: 可以借英语 afford 的熟悉拼写记忆 affordja，再想象付款前查看钱包；学习时把金钱、时间两种“承担得起”的场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Afghanistan, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与阿富汗、阿富汗人民或阿富汗文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Afganistan, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿富汗的；与阿富汗人民或文化有关的。
阿富汗人。

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi laqgħa ma' kittieb Afgan, li se jitkellem dwar il-letteratura u l-esperjenzi personali tiegħu.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes a meeting with an Afghan writer, who will speak about literature and his personal experiences.
formal.zh: 文化活动安排包括与一位阿富汗作家见面，他将谈论文学及自己的亲身经历。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ikel iservu f'dak ir-ristorant? Sami: Ikel Afgan. Jien Afgan, u xi platti jfakkruni fl-ikel li kienet issajjar ommi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of food do they serve at that restaurant? Sami: Afghan food. I'm Afghan, and some dishes remind me of the food my mother used to cook.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那家餐馆供应什么菜？Sami：阿富汗菜。我是阿富汗人，有些菜让我想起妈妈以前做的饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那家餐馆供应什么菜？
messages.en: What kind of food do they serve at that restaurant?

messages.speaker: Sami (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikel Afgan. Jien Afgan, u xi platti jfakkruni fl-ikel li kienet issajjar ommi.
messages.mt_standard: Ikel Afgan. Jien Afgan, u xi platti jfakkruni fl-ikel li kienet issajjar ommi.
messages.zh: 阿富汗菜。我是阿富汗人，有些菜让我想起妈妈以前做的饭。
messages.en: Afghan food. I'm Afghan, and some dishes remind me of the food my mother used to cook.

afgan.cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张词卡区分词性：ikel Afgan 是“阿富汗食物”，Afgan 修饰食物；Jien Afgan 是“我是阿富汗人”，Afgan 在这里指人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Africa, the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic and Indian Oceans.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非洲，位于欧洲以南、大西洋与印度洋之间的大陆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kontinent fin-Nofsinhar tal-Ewropa, bejn l-Oċean Atlantiku u l-Oċean Indjan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非洲。

sense_translations.en_definition: Africa (the continent south of Europe and between the Atlantic and Indian Oceans)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 非洲，位于欧洲以南、大西洋与印度洋之间的大陆。

formal.mt: L-istudenti studjaw il-pożizzjoni tal-Afrika fuq il-mappa tad-dinja.
formal.en: The students studied Africa's location on the world map.
formal.zh: 学生们研究了非洲在世界地图上的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nixtieq inżur l-Afrika xi darba. Mark: Liema pajjiż tixtieq iżżur l-ewwel?
colloquial.en: Maja: I'd like to visit Africa someday. Mark: Which country would you like to visit first?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我想有一天去非洲看看。Mark：你想先去哪个国家？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想有一天去非洲看看。
messages.en: I'd like to visit Africa someday.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想先去哪个国家？
messages.en: Which country would you like to visit first?

afrika.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Afrika 与地图上的非洲大陆对应起来，再用 l-Afrika ta' Fuq 记住“北非”；地名首字母要大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word that describes a noun or gives information about its qualities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容词，用来描述名词或说明其性质的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tiddeskrivi nom jew tagħti informazzjoni dwar il-kwalitajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: an adjective (the part of speech or grammatical category)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容词，一种词类或语法类别。
形容词。
形容词。

formal.mt: Fil-frażi 'dar kbira', il-kelma 'kbira' hija aġġettiv li jiddeskrivi n-nom 'dar'.
formal.en: In the phrase 'dar kbira' ('a large house'), the word 'kbira' is an adjective describing the noun 'dar'.
formal.zh: 在短语 dar kbira（大房子）中，kbira 是描述名词 dar 的形容词。

colloquial.mt: Lara: 'Sabiħ' huwa aġġettiv? Pawlu: Iva, bħal fil-frażi 'ġnien sabiħ'.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is 'sabiħ' an adjective? Pawlu: Yes, as in the phrase 'ġnien sabiħ', meaning 'a beautiful garden'.
colloquial.zh: Lara：sabiħ 是形容词吗？Pawlu：是的，比如 ġnien sabiħ，意思是“美丽的花园”。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: sabiħ 是形容词吗？
messages.en: Is 'sabiħ' an adjective?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.zh: 是的，比如 ġnien sabiħ，意思是“美丽的花园”。
messages.en: Yes, as in the phrase 'ġnien sabiħ', meaning 'a beautiful garden'.

aġġettiv.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 aġġettiv，就问“这个词在描述什么样的事物？”把 dar kbira 中表示“大”的 kbira 圈出来，建立形容词的直观印象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An update to information, or the adjournment or temporary suspension of a meeting or other proceedings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信息的更新；也指会议等议事活动的延期或暂时休会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġdid ta' informazzjoni, jew posponiment jew waqfa temporanja ta' laqgħa jew seduta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 会议或议事程序的延期、休会。
将会议或议事程序延期、暂时中止的行为。
更新；使信息或内容反映最新情况的行为。
休会；会议或议事程序中的暂时休息。

formal.mt: Il-president ħabbar l-aġġornament tas-seduta sal-għada.
formal.en: The chair announced the adjournment of the sitting until the following day.
formal.zh: 主席宣布休会，会议于次日继续。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm xi aġġornament dwar il-laqgħa? David: Iva, se tibda fl-għaxra minflok fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any update about the meeting? David: Yes, it will start at ten instead of nine.
colloquial.zh: Sara：会议有什么最新消息吗？David：有，开始时间从九点改到十点了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 会议有什么最新消息吗？
messages.en: Is there any update about the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se tibda fl-għaxra minflok fid-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se tibda fl-għaxra minflok fid-disgħa.
messages.zh: 有，开始时间从九点改到十点了。
messages.en: Yes, it will start at ten instead of nine.

aġġornament.cognitive_memory_aid: 给 aġġornament 配两张学习卡：信息页面写“更新”，会议时钟写“延期、休会”；看搭配判断当前使用哪个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take action in a situation or to behave in a particular way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某种情况下采取行动，或以某种方式行事、表现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jieħu azzjoni f'sitwazzjoni jew iġib ruħu b'ċertu mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行动；行事。
采取行动；着手应对某种情况。
行事；表现出某种行为方式。

formal.mt: Il-maniġer aġixxa malajr biex isolvi l-problema u informa lill-impjegati.
formal.en: The manager acted quickly to resolve the problem and informed the employees.
formal.zh: 经理迅速采取行动解决问题，并通知了员工。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif aġixxa Mark meta sema' l-aħbar? Lara: Baqa' kalm u aġixxa b'responsabbiltà.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did Mark act when he heard the news? Lara: He stayed calm and acted responsibly.
colloquial.zh: Nina：Mark 听到这个消息后表现怎么样？Lara：他保持冷静，处理得很负责任。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif aġixxa Mark meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif aġixxa Mark meta sema' l-aħbar?
messages.zh: Mark 听到这个消息后表现怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark act when he heard the news?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他保持冷静，处理得很负责任。
messages.en: He stayed calm and acted responsibly.

aġixxa.cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个问题记住 aġixxa：“他采取行动了吗？”和“他表现如何？”再把 malajr 配成“迅速行动”，把 b'responsabbiltà 配成“负责任地行事”。

aggravant.gloss_zh: 加重；使情况恶化的因素

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aggravation: something that makes a problem or situation more serious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使问题或情况变得更加严重的加重因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fattur li jagħmel problema jew sitwazzjoni aktar gravi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加重；使问题或情况更加严重的因素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li żżid il-gravità ta' problema jew sitwazzjoni.

collocations.zh: 另一个使情况恶化的因素

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' komunikazzjoni kien aggravant ieħor fil-kriżi.
formal.en: The lack of communication was another aggravating factor in the crisis.
formal.zh: 沟通不足是使这场危机进一步恶化的又一个因素。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ix-xogħol diġà tard. Pawlu: Iva, u n-nuqqas ta' materjal huwa aggravant ieħor.
colloquial.en: Marta: The work is already behind schedule. Pawlu: Yes, and the shortage of materials is another aggravating factor.
colloquial.zh: Marta：工作已经延误了。Pawlu：是啊，材料不足又让情况更加严重。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 工作已经延误了。
messages.en: The work is already behind schedule.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u n-nuqqas ta' materjal huwa aggravant ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u n-nuqqas ta' materjal huwa aggravant ieħor.
messages.zh: 是啊，材料不足又让情况更加严重。
messages.en: Yes, and the shortage of materials is another aggravating factor.

aggravant.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象问题已经很重，又有人往上加一块石头：aggravant 就是让情况进一步加重的因素。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To assault or attack someone, or to behave fiercely towards them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人实施袭击或攻击，或以凶狠、带有攻击性的方式对待某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jattakka lil xi ħadd jew iġib ruħu b'mod aħrax u aggressiv lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 袭击；对某人实施身体上的暴力攻击。
攻击；向某人或某个目标发起攻击。
凶狠地对待；以强烈的敌意或攻击性对待某人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'mod aħrax u aggressiv lejn xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实施侵攻击行为；主动向某人发起攻击。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jaġixxi b'aggressjoni jew jattakka lil xi ħadd.

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel aggredixxa lill-vittma barra mill-istazzjon.
formal.en: According to the report, the man assaulted the victim outside the station.
formal.zh: 据报告，该男子在车站外袭击了受害者。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex telaq Mark daqshekk kmieni? Pawlu: Raġel aggredixxa lil Mark verbalment, u Mark ma riedx jibqa' hemm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Mark leave so early? Pawlu: A man verbally attacked Mark, and Mark did not want to stay there.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 为什么这么早就走了？Pawlu：有个男人对 Mark 进行了言语攻击，Mark 就不想继续待在那里了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么这么早就走了？
messages.en: Why did Mark leave so early?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Raġel aggredixxa lil Mark verbalment, u Mark ma riedx jibqa' hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Raġel aggredixxa lil Mark verbalment, u Mark ma riedx jibqa' hemm.
messages.zh: 有个男人对 Mark 进行了言语攻击，Mark 就不想继续待在那里了。
messages.en: A man verbally attacked Mark, and Mark did not want to stay there.

aggredixxa.cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆 aggredixxa：动手袭击和开口攻击；搭配 fiżikament 或 verbalment，区分身体攻击与言语攻击。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In an aggressive, hostile, or forceful manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以带有攻击性、敌意或强硬逼人的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod aggressiv, ostili jew ta' theddid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击性地；气势汹汹地；咄咄逼人地。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti ġew mitluba jesprimu n-nuqqas ta' qbil tagħhom mingħajr ma jitkellmu aggressivament.
formal.en: The participants were asked to express their disagreement without speaking aggressively.
formal.zh: 参与者被要求表达自己的不同意见，同时避免使用咄咄逼人的语气。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tkellimni aggressivament? Mark: Skużani, jien irrabjat, imma m'għandix inkellmek hekk.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you speaking to me so aggressively? Mark: Sorry, I am angry, but I should not speak to you like that.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么这么凶地跟我说话？Mark：对不起，我在生气，但我不该这样跟你说话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么这么凶地跟我说话？
messages.en: Why are you speaking to me so aggressively?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, jien irrabjat, imma m'għandix inkellmek hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, jien irrabjat, imma m'għandix inkellmek hekk.
messages.zh: 对不起，我在生气，但我不该这样跟你说话。
messages.en: Sorry, I am angry, but I should not speak to you like that.

aggressivament.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aggressivament 放在“怎样说话、怎样行动”的问题后面记忆：它描述方式，意思是带着攻击性或咄咄逼人地。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Hostile or violent behaviour directed against another person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对他人或群体的敌对、攻击或暴力行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba ostili jew vjolenti kontra persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击行为；侵略；针对他人的敌对或进攻行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imġiba ostili jew attakk kontra ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴力；使用武力伤害他人的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu tal-forza biex issir ħsara lil ħaddieħor.

collocations.zh: 身体上的攻击；肢体暴力

formal.mt: L-iskola adottat miżuri biex tipprevjeni l-aggressjoni fiżika u verbali bejn l-istudenti.
formal.en: The school adopted measures to prevent physical and verbal aggression between students.
formal.zh: 学校采取了措施，以预防学生之间的肢体攻击和言语攻击。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'ġara fil-logħba? David: Kien hemm aggressjoni bejn żewġ plejers, u r-referee waqqaf il-logħba.
colloquial.en: Anna: What happened during the match? David: There was violence between two players, and the referee stopped the match.
colloquial.zh: Anna：比赛中发生什么事了？David：两名球员之间发生了暴力冲突，裁判就叫停了比赛。

messages.speaker: Anna (球迷)
messages.zh: 比赛中发生什么事了？
messages.en: What happened during the match?

messages.speaker: David (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm aggressjoni bejn żewġ plejers, u r-referee waqqaf il-logħba.
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm aggressjoni bejn żewġ plejers, u r-referee waqqaf il-logħba.
messages.zh: 两名球员之间发生了暴力冲突，裁判就叫停了比赛。
messages.en: There was violence between two players, and the referee stopped the match.

aggressjoni.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aggressjoni 想成事件记录里“发生了什么”的答案：发生了攻击或暴力。它是名词，可用 att ta' aggressjoni 记住一次攻击行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being left without care, support, or maintenance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物被遗弃、失去照料，或长期无人维护的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' persuna jew ħaġa li titħalla mingħajr kura, għajnuna jew manutenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗弃；弃置；疏于照料或维护。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istat ta' abbandun tal-bini u jitlob manutenzjoni urġenti.
formal.en: The report describes the building's state of neglect and calls for urgent maintenance.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该建筑长期失修的状态，并要求紧急维护。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-ġnien jinsab fi stat ta' abbandun? Mark: Ħadd ma jieħu ħsiebu. Ejja nistaqsu lill-kunsill.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is this garden in a state of neglect? Mark: Nobody looks after it. Let's ask the council.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个花园为什么荒废了？Mark：没人照料它。我们去问问地方议会吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-ġnien jinsab fi stat ta' abbandun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-ġnien jinsab fi stat ta' abbandun?
messages.zh: 这个花园为什么荒废了？
messages.en: Why is this garden in a state of neglect?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadd ma jieħu ħsiebu. Ejja nistaqsu lill-kunsill.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadd ma jieħu ħsiebu. Ejja nistaqsu lill-kunsill.
messages.zh: 没人照料它。我们去问问地方议会吧。
messages.en: Nobody looks after it. Let's ask the council.

abbandun.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 abbandun 配上杂草丛生的空屋画面，记住它表示被弃置或无人照管的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boy who assists the priest during Mass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在弥撒中协助神父进行礼仪的男童。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel li jgħin lis-saċerdot waqt il-quddiesa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辅祭男童；在弥撒中协助神父的男孩。
男修道院院长；领导修士团体的男性宗教负责人。

formal.mt: Waqt il-quddiesa, l-abbati għen lis-saċerdot u ġab il-ktieb fuq l-artal.
formal.en: During Mass, the altar boy assisted the priest and brought the book to the altar.
formal.zh: 弥撒期间，辅祭男童协助神父，把书送到祭台上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak it-tifel ħdejn is-saċerdot? Pawlu: Dak l-abbati. Qed jgħin waqt il-quddiesa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that boy next to the priest? Pawlu: That's the altar boy. He's helping during Mass.
colloquial.zh: Sara：神父旁边那个男孩是谁？Pawlu：那是辅祭男童。他正在协助弥撒。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak it-tifel ħdejn is-saċerdot?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak it-tifel ħdejn is-saċerdot?
messages.zh: 神父旁边那个男孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is that boy next to the priest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak l-abbati. Qed jgħin waqt il-quddiesa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak l-abbati. Qed jgħin waqt il-quddiesa.
messages.zh: 那是辅祭男童。他正在协助弥撒。
messages.en: That's the altar boy. He's helping during Mass.

abbati.cognitive_memory_aid: 为 abbati 画两张人物卡：祭台旁的辅祭男童，以及修道院的院长；靠场景区分两个义项。

abbazija.gloss_zh: 修道院；修道院院长职位或任期

teaching_sense.en_definition: A monastery that houses a religious community under an abbot or abbess.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由男院长或女院长领导、供宗教团体共同生活的修道院。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Monasteru fejn tgħix komunità reliġjuża taħt it-tmexxija ta' abbati jew abbadessa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修道院；由男院长或女院长领导的修道团体及其院舍。
修道院院长的职位或任期；修道院。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jidħlu fil-knisja tal-abbazija waqt il-ħinijiet indikati.
formal.en: Visitors may enter the abbey church during the indicated hours.
formal.zh: 游客可在标明的时段进入修道院教堂。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Immorru nżuru l-abbazija għada? David: Iva, nixtieq nara l-knisja u l-ġnien tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we visit the abbey tomorrow? David: Yes, I'd like to see its church and garden.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们明天去参观修道院好吗？David：好，我想看看那里的教堂和花园。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们明天去参观修道院好吗？
messages.en: Shall we visit the abbey tomorrow?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nara l-knisja u l-ġnien tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nara l-knisja u l-ġnien tagħha.
messages.zh: 好，我想看看那里的教堂和花园。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to see its church and garden.

abbazija.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 abbazija，先想有教堂和庭院的修道院；再用院长办公桌提醒自己还有职位或任期义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put two things together as a pair or combine things so that they work well together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把两个事物配成一对，或将不同事物搭配、组合起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħaqqad żewġ affarijiet flimkien jew jagħżel affarijiet li jaqblu ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把事物配成一对；将事物搭配或组合起来。

collocations.en: pair the wine with the food

formal.mt: Id-disinjatur abbina l-kuluri tal-ħitan ma' dawk tal-għamara biex joħloq dehra armonjuża.
formal.en: The designer matched the wall colours with those of the furniture to create a harmonious look.
formal.zh: 设计师将墙壁颜色与家具颜色搭配起来，营造协调的视觉效果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma' xiex nista' nabbina din il-qmis blu? Mark: Abbina l-qmis ma' qalziet griż.
colloquial.en: Nina: What can I pair this blue shirt with? Mark: Pair the shirt with grey trousers.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这件蓝衬衫可以搭配什么？Mark：把它和灰裤子搭配吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma' xiex nista' nabbina din il-qmis blu?
messages.mt_standard: Ma' xiex nista' nabbina din il-qmis blu?
messages.zh: 这件蓝衬衫可以搭配什么？
messages.en: What can I pair this blue shirt with?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 把它和灰裤子搭配吧。
messages.en: Pair the shirt with grey trousers.

abbina.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 abbina 想成穿衣前把衬衫和裤子摆在一起：重点是让两个东西配对、搭配或组合。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the skill and ability to do a task well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有完成某项工作所需的能力和技巧，做事熟练的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila u l-kapaċità jagħmel xogħol tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 熟练的；有技巧的；技艺娴熟的。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tfittex ħaddiem abbli li jista' jsewwi tagħmir delikat.
formal.en: The company is looking for a skilled worker who can repair delicate equipment.
formal.zh: 公司正在寻找一名能够修理精密设备的熟练工人。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Taf lil xi ħadd li jista' jsewwi dan is-siġġu? Pawlu: Iva, naf mastrudaxxa abbli. Nagħtik in-numru tiegħu.

abbona.gloss_zh: 订阅；替人付费订阅；给予折扣

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订阅刊物；付费订用某项服务。

sense_translations.en_definition: to subscribe (someone) (to something) (to pay for someone's subscription to something)

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文章、计划或图画尚可修改的初步版本、提纲或草图。

敢于；胆敢做某事。

abolixxa.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 abolixxa 和盖着“正式废除”印章的旧法规放在同一幅记忆画面里，记住它强调制度或规定被取消。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To end a pregnancy through an induced abortion, or to lose a pregnancy through miscarriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过人工流产终止妊娠，或因自然流产而失去妊娠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Itemm tqala b'intervent apposta, jew jitlef tqala b'mod spontanju.

sense_translations.en_definition: to abort a pregnancy, to have a miscarriage
sense_translations.zh_definition: 终止妊娠；发生自然流产。

collocations.en: had an abortion or miscarriage in the first months of pregnancy
collocations.zh: 在妊娠最初几个月终止妊娠或发生流产

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li l-pazjenta abortiet spontanjament fit-tieni xahar tat-tqala.
formal.en: The report indicates that the patient had a spontaneous miscarriage in the second month of pregnancy.
formal.zh: 报告显示，该患者在妊娠第二个月发生了自然流产。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Sara qaltli li abortiet spontanjament. | Nina: Jiddispjaċini ħafna. Jekk trid titkellem, nista' noqgħod nismagħha.

colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：萨拉告诉我，她自然流产了。 | 妮娜：听到这件事我很难过。如果她想聊聊，我可以听她说。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 萨拉告诉我，她自然流产了。
messages.en: Sara told me she had a miscarriage.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)

aborta.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 aborta 放在“妊娠提前结束”的情境卡上；遇到 spontanjament 时联想自然发生，避免仅凭这个动词判断是否人为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the armpit or the area beneath the shoulder where the arm joins the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与腋窝有关的，或位于手臂与躯干连接处下方区域的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-koxxa ta' taħt id-driegħ jew li jinsab f'dik iż-żona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腋窝的；与腋部有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi nefħa fir-reġjun abti tax-xellug.
formal.en: The report describes swelling in the left axillary region.
formal.zh: 报告描述了左侧腋部的肿胀。

colloquial.en: Marija: What does 'abti' mean in this report? | David: It means relating to the armpit.

messages.zh: 意思是与腋窝有关的。

abti.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人体图上腋窝位置贴着 abti 标签；它是说明部位的形容词，可与“区域”或“疼痛”搭配记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To agree to receive something or approve a proposal; also, to tolerate or allow behavior that may be considered wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同意收下某物或接受某项提议；也可指容忍或默许被认为不当的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbel li jieħu xi ħaġa jew li jilqa' proposta; jista' jfisser ukoll li jittollera jew iħalli mġiba meqjusa ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接受；同意收下或采纳。
容忍或默许不當行为；对其不予反对或追究。

formal.mt: Id-direttur aċċetta l-proposta, iżda għamilha ċara li ma kienx se jaċċetta mġiba offensiva waqt il-laqgħat.
formal.en: The director accepted the proposal but made it clear that he would not condone offensive behavior during meetings.
formal.zh: 主任接受了这项提议，但明确表示不会容忍会议期间的冒犯行为。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Suitable for a particular person, purpose, activity, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 适合某个人、用途、活动或情境的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaqbel ma' persuna, skop, attività jew sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合适的；适用的；符合某种用途或条件的。

formal.mt: Dan il-kors huwa adatt għal studenti li għadhom jibdew jitgħallmu l-Malti.
formal.en: This course is suitable for students who are just beginning to learn Maltese.
formal.zh: 这门课程适合刚开始学习马耳他语的学生。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-film adatt għat-tfal? | Anna: Iva, nistgħu narawh flimkien mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this film suitable for children? | Anna: Yes, we can watch it together as a family.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这部电影适合孩子看吗？ | 安娜：适合，我们可以全家一起看。

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.zh: 这部电影适合孩子看吗？
messages.en: Is this film suitable for children?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.zh: 适合，我们可以全家一起看。
messages.en: Yes, we can watch it together as a family.

adatt.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 adatt 想成“用途匹配”的标签：书适合初学者、电影适合儿童；学习时总追问一句“适合谁或什么用途”。

addoċċ.gloss_zh: 随意地；随机地；杂乱无章地

teaching_sense.en_definition: In a random way, without a fixed order, deliberate selection, or careful planning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以随机、没有固定顺序、未经刻意挑选或缺乏周密安排的方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod każwali, mingħajr ordni fissa, għażla apposta jew ippjanar bir-reqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 毫无章法地；缺乏计划或条理地。
随机地；不按特定次序或标准地。
随机地；随意地；杂乱无章地。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur għażel għaxar ismijiet addoċċ mil-lista tal-parteċipanti.
formal.en: The researcher selected ten names at random from the list of participants.
formal.zh: 研究人员从参与者名单中随机选出了十个名字。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema karta għandi nieħu? | Ben: Ħu waħda addoċċ, mingħajr ma tħares.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which card should I take? | Ben: Take one at random, without looking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我该拿哪张牌？ | 本：别看，随便抽一张。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我该拿哪张牌？

messages.zh: 别看，随便抽一张。
messages.en: Take one at random, without looking.

addoċċ.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闭眼抽牌来记 addoċċ 的“随机地”，再想象桌上乱扔的纸张来记“毫无章法地”；具体语境决定是否带批评意味。

adorazzjoni.gloss_zh: 爱慕；崇敬；对上帝的敬拜

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deep love or reverent admiration for someone or something; also, worship directed to God.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某物怀有深切的爱慕或崇敬；也指向上帝表达的敬拜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imħabba profonda jew ammirazzjoni mimlija qima lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; ukoll qima lil Alla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深切的爱慕；崇敬；热爱。
对上帝的敬拜、崇拜或礼拜。

formal.mt: Il-komunità nġabret fil-knisja għal siegħa ta' adorazzjoni u talb.
formal.en: The community gathered in the church for an hour of worship and prayer.
formal.zh: 教会团体聚集在教堂里，进行了一小时的敬拜和祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Rajt kif it-tifla ħarset lejn ommha? | Toni: Iva, kienet ħarsa ta' adorazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Elena: Did you see how the girl looked at her mother? | Toni: Yes, it was a look of adoration.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你看到那个小女孩望着妈妈的样子了吗？ | 托尼：看到了，那目光里满是爱慕。

adorazzjoni.cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 adorazzjoni：孩子满怀爱意望着母亲，以及信众向上帝敬拜；共同点是强烈的爱与崇敬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Taken into a family as a child, or formally accepted for use, as with a plan, policy, or method.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为子女被家庭收养的；也指计划、政策或方法等已被正式采纳使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Milqugħ f'familja bħala wild, jew aċċettat uffiċjalment biex jintuża, bħal pjan jew metodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被收养的；已被采纳或采用的。

formal.mt: Il-metodu adottat mill-iskola jagħti aktar ħin lill-istudenti biex jipprattikaw il-lingwa.
formal.en: The method adopted by the school gives students more time to practice the language.
formal.zh: 学校采用的方法让学生有更多时间练习语言。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min hu Leo f'dan ir-rumanz? | Nina: Huwa tifel adottat li jmur jgħix ma' familja f'Għawdex.

colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这部小说里的利奥是谁？ | 妮娜：他是一个被收养的男孩，后来到戈佐岛的一个家庭生活。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a substance impure or lower its quality by mixing another substance into it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 往某种物质中掺入其他成分，使其不纯或品质降低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħallat sustanza ma' oħra b'mod li jnaqqas il-purità jew il-kwalità tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掺假；通过混入其他物质降低纯度或品质。

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-lezzjoni, il-bejjiegħ adultera l-ħalib bl-ilma u b'hekk naqqas il-kwalità tiegħu.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who worships a deity or deeply admires someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敬拜神明的人，或对某人、某事物怀有深切仰慕的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqim lil xi divinità jew li tammira ħafna lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 敬拜者；进行宗教崇拜的人。
仰慕者；十分欣赏某人或某事物的人。

formal.mt: Fl-esej tiegħu, l-awtur jiddeskrivi lilu nnifsu bħala aduratur tal-arti u jispjega għaliex iżur il-mużewijiet regolarment.
formal.en: In his essay, the author describes himself as an admirer of art and explains why he visits museums regularly.
formal.zh: 作者在文章中称自己是艺术的仰慕者，并解释了自己为什么经常参观博物馆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extremely interesting or charming in a way that strongly attracts attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 非常有趣或富有魅力，能够牢牢吸引注意力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiġbed ħafna l-attenzjoni għax ikun interessanti ħafna jew mimli seħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极有吸引力的；让人产生浓厚兴趣的。
引人入胜的；迷人而富有魅力的。

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jippreżenta rakkont affaxxinanti li jżomm lill-qarrej interessat sal-aħħar paġna.
formal.en: The book presents a fascinating narrative that keeps the reader interested until the final page.
formal.zh: 这本书讲述了一个引人入胜的故事，让读者一直读到最后一页仍兴致盎然。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have an influence on someone or something, causing a change in their condition, feelings, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事物产生影响，使其状态、感受或处境发生变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu effett fuq xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa u jġib bidla fil-qagħda, fis-sentimenti jew fis-sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 影响；使某人或某事物的状态、感受或处境发生变化。

affiljazzjoni.gloss_zh: 隶属关系；组织关联；成员归属

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过成员身份、联系或正式隶属而与某个组织或团体建立的关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta ma' organizzazzjoni jew grupp permezz ta' sħubija, assoċjazzjoni jew rabta formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与组织或团体的隶属、成员归属或关联关系。

collocations.zh: 与大学的隶属或关联关系

formal.mt: Fil-formola tal-konferenza, kull riċerkatur għandu jindika l-affiljazzjoni tiegħu ma' università jew istituzzjoni oħra.

formal.zh: 每位研究人员都应在会议表格中注明自己所属的大学或其他机构。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To face a problem, difficulty, or challenge and try to deal with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对问题、困难或挑战，并着手设法应对或处理。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiffaċċja problema, diffikultà jew sfida u jipprova jittratta magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对；积极应对或着手处理问题、困难或挑战。

collocations.zh: 面对或着手处理了一个问题
面对或着手应对了一项挑战

formal.mt: It-tim affronta l-problema billi analizza l-kawżi tagħha u ħejja pjan ta' azzjoni.
formal.en: The team tackled the problem by analyzing its causes and preparing an action plan.
formal.zh: 团队通过分析问题的成因并制定行动计划，着手解决了这个问题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ix-xogħol tal-grupp? Mark: It-tim affronta l-problema flimkien. Maja: U sibtu soluzzjoni? Mark: Iva, wara li tkellimna kollha.

messages.en: Yes, after we all talked it through.

affronta.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 affronta 记成“站到问题面前，开始想办法处理”：既有面对困难的意思，也有主动应对的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Afghanistan, a landlocked country between Central Asia and South Asia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 阿富汗，位于中亚与南亚之间的内陆国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż mingħajr kosta li jinsab bejn l-Asja Ċentrali u l-Asja tan-Nofsinhar.

sense_translations.en_definition: Afghanistan (a landlocked country between Central Asia and South Asia; official name: Repubblika Iżlamika tal-Afganistan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 阿富汗，位于中亚与南亚之间的内陆国家；本义项所列正式名称为“阿富汗伊斯兰共和国”。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tal-ġeografija, l-istudenti użaw mappa biex jidentifikaw il-pożizzjoni tal-Afganistan bejn l-Asja Ċentrali u l-Asja tan-Nofsinhar.
formal.en: In the geography lesson, the students used a map to identify Afghanistan's location between Central Asia and South Asia.

colloquial.en: Nina: Where is Afghanistan on this map? Pawlu: Here, between Central Asia and South Asia. Nina: Does it have a coastline? Pawlu: No, it's a landlocked country.
colloquial.zh: Nina：阿富汗在这张地图的哪里？Pawlu：这里，在中亚与南亚之间。Nina：它有海岸线吗？Pawlu：没有，它是内陆国家。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A language referred to in Maltese as Afrikans.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种语言的名称，中文称为南非荷兰语，英语称为 Afrikaans。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem ta' lingwa magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Afrikaans.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 南非荷兰语（一种语言）。

formal.mt: Il-kors joffri introduzzjoni għall-Afrikans permezz ta' testi qosra u eżerċizzji.

formal.zh: 本课程通过短文和练习介绍南非荷兰语的基础知识。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To postpone or suspend a meeting or sitting, or to bring information or something else up to date.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使会议或议事程序暂时结束、延期继续；也指更新信息等，使其符合最新情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipposponi jew jissospendi laqgħa jew seduta, jew jagħmel informazzjoni jew xi ħaġa oħra aktar attwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宣布休会；将会议或议事程序延期继续。
更新；使信息、资料等符合最新情况。

formal.zh: 主席宣布休会，会议将于星期一继续。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change made to improve how something fits, works, or suits a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为使某物更合适、运作更好或适应情况而作出的调整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla li ssir biex xi ħaġa tkun aktar adattata jew taħdem aħjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 调整；调节；为改善适合程度或运作状态而作出的改变。

formal.mt: Sar aġġustament fl-iskeda biex jingħata aktar ħin għad-diskussjoni.
formal.en: An adjustment was made to the schedule to allow more time for discussion.
formal.zh: 日程作了调整，以便留出更多讨论时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-istampa tidher ftit skura. Mark: Nagħmel aġġustament żgħir fil-luminożità.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make a problem or an already difficult situation worse or more serious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使问题或已经不好的情况变得更严重、更糟糕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel problema jew sitwazzjoni diffiċli agħar jew aktar serja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加重；使问题、困难或不良情况进一步恶化。

formal.mt: Id-dewmien fit-tiswijiet aggrava l-problema tat-tnixxija tal-ilma.
formal.en: The delay in repairs aggravated the water leak problem.
formal.zh: 维修延误使漏水问题更加严重。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-traffiku kien ħażin dalgħodu? Mark: Iva, u x-xita aggravat is-sitwazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was the traffic bad this morning? Mark: Yes, and the rain made the situation worse.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天早上交通很糟吗？Mark：是啊，下雨又让情况更糟了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 今天早上交通很糟吗？
messages.en: Was the traffic bad this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (通勤者)
messages.zh: 是啊，下雨又让情况更糟了。
messages.en: Yes, and the rain made the situation worse.

aggrava.cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从“已经不好”指向“更加严重”的箭头，箭头上的动作就是 aggrava，突出“使之加重”。

aggravanti.gloss_zh: 使情况加重的；加剧问题的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Making a problem, situation, or offence more serious.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使问题、情况或过错的严重程度增加的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħmel problema, sitwazzjoni jew reat aktar gravi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使情况恶化的；使问题或过错更加严重的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport identifika n-nuqqas ta' komunikazzjoni bħala fattur aggravanti fil-kriżi.

formal.zh: 报告指出，沟通不足是加剧危机的一个因素。

aggressiv.gloss_zh: 好斗的；咄咄逼人的；具有攻击性的

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易攻击、挑衅他人，或表现得强硬、具有威胁性的。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有攻击性的；好斗的；态度咄咄逼人的。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击性；好斗性；行为中表现出的挑衅或威胁倾向。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew grupp li jattakka lil ħaddieħor jew jibda aggressjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 攻击者；侵略者；主动发动攻击的一方。
